# who is my sample
## gender, sexual ID

```{r}
table(data_full$trans)

view(data_full %>%
       group_by(trans)%>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    man = sum(man, na.rm = TRUE), 
    woman = sum(woman, na.rm = TRUE),
    gqueer       = sum(gqueer, na.rm = TRUE),
    g_other = sum(g_other, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

view(data_full %>%
  group_by(man) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

view(data_full %>%
  group_by(woman) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

view(data_full %>%

view(data_full %>%
```

## state, county

```{r}


state_percent_2020 <- read_csv("state_percent_2020.csv")

state_percent_2020 <- state_percent_2020 %>%
  mutate(
    percent_2020 = readr::parse_number(oct)
  )

view(state_percent_2020)

where <- data_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(state)) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / nrow(data_full)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    state_percent_2020,
    by = "state"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
    delta = (percent - percent_2020)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

View(where)

view(data_full %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    White = sum(White, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Black = sum(Black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hisp_Latino       = sum(Hisp_Latino, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian_Am     = sum(Asian_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    Native_am = sum(Native_Am, na.rm = TRUE),
    OtherRace = sum(OtherRace, na.rm = TRUE)
  ))

```
